'''Andy Klema''' is a core member of [[Kashyyyk Train of Dominance]]. The Players Committee Hall of Fame entry for [[Justin Desai]] and a 2024 Garbage Rollers community spotlight name him with Desai, [[Mike Gemme]], and [[Steve Baroni]] as the New England group that formed around 2002.<ref name="hof">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/community/awards/ Awards and Hall of Fame], Players Committee</ref><ref name="gr">[https://garbagerollers.com/2024/02/02/community-spotlight-ktod-feb-2nd-2024/ Community Spotlight: KToD], Garbage Rollers (2 February 2024)</ref>
